info.name: Google FX Flow Automation API (Production - gen.socialversal.online)
info.description:
Postman Collection for Google FX Flow Avatar Video Generation API running on VPS.

**Base URL:** `https://gen.socialversal.online`

**Available Endpoints:**
- `POST /api/fx-flow/generate-avatar-video` → Main generation endpoint (only one)
- `GET /api/fx-flow/status/:itemId` → Poll job status & fetch result

**Full Automation Flow (in order):**
1. Navigate to Google FX Flow → Create New Project
2. Enable Agent mode (pill button)
3. Click Expand button → opens right-side Agent panel
4. Add account avatar ("me") to prompt via + button
5. Upload reference image (mediaUrl/imageUrl) → wait for upload → add to prompt
6. Open Agent Settings (tune icon) → set aspectRatio, model, duration, confirm=Never → Save
7. Type prompt + Submit → Poll for video generation result

**Settings Notes:**
- `aspectRatio`: "9:16", "16:9", "1:1", "4:3", "3:4"
- `model`: "Omni Flash" (default) | "Veo 3.1 - Lite" | "Veo 3.1 - Fast" | "Veo 3.1 - Quality"
- `duration`: 4 | 6 | 8 | 10 (seconds, number — NOT string)
- `avatarName`: "me" (uses the logged-in account avatar)

request.description:
**The only generation endpoint.**

Submits an avatar video generation job. The server runs a full browser automation flow:
1. Creates a new Google FX Flow project
2. Enables Agent mode
3. Clicks the Expand button (opens right-side Agent panel)
4. Adds the account avatar (`avatarName`) to the prompt via the `+` button
5. Uploads the reference image (`mediaUrl`/`imageUrl`), waits for upload to finish, adds to prompt
6. Opens Agent Settings (tune icon) → sets aspectRatio, model, duration, confirm=Never → Saves
7. Types and submits the prompt
8. Polls for video generation → downloads result

**Parameters:**
- `prompt` (required): Text/JSON description for the video
- `avatarName` (optional, default `"me"`): Account avatar to select
- `mediaUrl` or `imageUrl` (optional): Reference image URL to upload into the prompt
- `settings.aspectRatio`: "9:16" | "16:9" | "1:1" | "4:3" | "3:4"
- `settings.model`: "Omni Flash" (default) | "Veo 3.1 - Lite" | "Veo 3.1 - Fast" | "Veo 3.1 - Quality"
- `settings.duration`: `8` (optional)

**Returns:** `itemId` — poll `/api/fx-flow/status/:itemId` to get results.

variable.description: The itemId returned by /generate-avatar-video (auto-set by test script)

request.description:
Poll this endpoint after submitting a job to check progress and get the result.

**Status values:**
- `pending` → job is queued
- `processing` → browser automation is running
- `completed` → done! Check `result.videoUrl`, `result.r2Url`, `r2Url`
- `failed` → check `error` field

**Tip:** Poll every 10–15 seconds. Avatar video generation typically takes 60–180 seconds.
